'''Fireheads''', also known as '''Rhinnalian fireheads''', were one of the strangest lifeforms on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]]. This nimble creatures was a limbed [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to the [[Water/Legends|frozen]] polar regions of the planet, and could be found on the surface of the [[Zirfan glacier]], where [[tenticulon]]s hunted them. They tunneled through glaciers by using the heat that emanated from a knobby growth on their upper jaw, which smoldered like a nubbin of molten [[Magma/Legends|lava]]. This same growth was also used to kill prey. A school of fireheads would hunt by ramming a larger creature, burning holes into its body, and then nibbling at the floating carcass.<ref name="CC" /> These creatures served as sources of both heat and food for the native [[Rhinnalian]]s.<ref name="CE" />

The population of Rhinnalian fireheads were among the millions of aquatic creatures living in the [[Royal Icqui Aquaria]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fireheads were first introduced in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a sourcebook for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]], published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on [[January 3]], [[2003]]. The sourcebook offered players several adventure hooks for their home campaigns. One such scenario, titled «Frozen in Time», pits a group of players against fireheads and [[tenticulon]]s.
